activity_summary: Before you walked up to Holywell, the almanac already said no play. The afternoon line is struck. You did not write what the bill had been called. The forty leaves are beside the book, ready to go.

entities.name: William Shakespeare
entities.context: Wrote the two words and did not name the bill.

entities.name: Richard II
entities.context: Mentioned in Forty leaves, and No play

facets.activity: Wrote across the struck line and took the forty leaves

topics: forty leaves unnamed on that line
